tool_args.rationale: Pilot signatures and verified branch guidance support the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The available fine trajectory batch is the relevant probe to add rows before fitting; the s_grad span is not narrow, so an open-branch discriminator is not indicated.

considered_alternatives.option: author_and_confirm_python_model: fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the current five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The verified mechanism requires at least eight trajectory rows to identify its five parameters; five rows leave insufficient independent information for reliable fresh confirmation.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and does not resolve the ODE parameter-identification or trajectory-confirmation need.
